protocol: rolling one-day-ahead; observed prior-day sales may be used for later test dates; fit is train-only; date-exact lags; missing history omitted
sample_scope: 50 sampled stores only; no claim of generalization to all 1,115 stores
transformer_unknown_store_policy: reserved embedding index 0; training samples use known store IDs
transformer_quantile_calibration: Per-quantile additive offsets fit on validation residual quantiles; final test is not used for calibration. Calibrated outputs are clipped to nonnegative sales and sorted.
